card.name: Clinical signs: tenderness, findings, triad
card.fires_on: The end of clinical sign words, such as the "erness" in tenderness, or the word "findings" after laboratory, neurological or MRI. It also fires on "tender" before skin nodules, and on the last part of "triad".
